Name: Punk Rock Sebastian
Author: FreakyBiscuit1
Description:
This was made for the incredibly talented [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Kantrip]Kantrip[/url] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31574]Older Sebastian Mod[/url]. HIGHLY recommend you play the expansion, as it gives him a gritty flavor and complexity.  
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Kantrip]Kantrip[/url][color=#d4d4d8] has fully integrated this portrait set into their character expansion for Seb, so this is the standalone version that changes his appearance [/color][color=#d4d4d8][b]only[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8]. If you play with their character expansion, you do not need to download this mod! [/color]

[left][color=#d4d4d8]This mod provides full Seasonal outfits with matching world sprites, with some festivals! It is very flexible - You can turn sprites and/or portraits off in the config options, and select between clean shaven and the 5'oclock shadow. [/color][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][line]
[/left]

[b]Note: If you are interested in adapting the assets of this mod, please contact me first. I'm happy to work with you! I do not permit any assets to be used with generative AI in any form.  [/b]
